question.text: At what rate is GST currently applicable on Management Fees charged by a Cat I/II AIF's Investment Manager, per Indian tax rules referenced in Chapter 6?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 6, GST at 18% applies on Management Fees, Trusteeship Fees, and fees to external service providers (administrators, custodians, auditors, legal advisors). The Trap: 12% and 28% are other GST slabs that do not apply to AIF management fees. The 'Nil (exempt as financial service)' option wrongly conflates the AIF's income-tax pass-through treatment with GST applicability on services rendered by the Manager — these are independent tax regimes. Note: GST on AIF management fees may not be recoverable as input tax credit at the fund level, since AIFs do not necessarily collect GST on their output services; this is the workbook's cautious framing.
